Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

All FAQsContact us
Does it cost anything to be placed?

No. The hiring employer pays our fee. There is never a charge to you.

Who is my employer?

The facility. You are hired directly, with their salary, benefits and career path.

Can I move from a contract to a permanent role?

Yes. Many clinicians try a facility on contract first. If you both want to make it permanent, we arrange it.
